messages:
Maya Lopez: heads-up from today's onboarding — customer flagged three small but recurring UX frictions. long notes bury the signal. can we try a super-compact "signal card" format for feedback capture?
Ravi Kapoor: yes please. anything that makes triage < 30s per item is a win. can you draft the card?
Maya Lopez: quick draft below. meant to be pasted into the customer note or a reply in-thread.
```
Signal Card
- TL;DR (1 line)
- Impact (who + ~# users or % flows)
- Desired behavior / Ask
- Frequency (how often it happens)
- Priority: P0/P1/P2
- Tags: onboarding | renewal-risk | perf | integrations
```
Aisha Patel: love the cadence — tiny ask: include a one-line suggested workaround (if any) so CS can unblock the customer while product evaluates.
Maya Lopez: updated sample with workaround + example filled card.
```
Signal Card
- TL;DR: search results hide relevant models when query > 5 tokens
- Impact: 2 pilot accounts, frequent for data scientists (~20% of searches)
- Ask: improve ranking for long queries or expose 'advanced' filter
- Frequency: daily
- Priority: P1
- Workaround: use filter "exact match" or use endpoint v2/query
- Tags: onboarding | perf
```
Tom Nguyen: can ProductOps wire a tiny form (Google Sheet or Confluence inline form) so SEs/CSMs can add cards and we can export to a triage board?
ProductOps Bot: Created Sheet: https://go.redwood.ai/cs-signal-cards (editable) 1/ Note: auto-labels populated from Tags column.
Ravi Kapoor: pilot plan suggestion: 2 weeks in onboarding + renewal outreach. targets: 20 signal cards total, at least 4 with quantitative impact, and weekly export to product triage. anything P0 goes to PM urgent queue immediately.
Aisha Patel: adding to onboarding checklist: "create 2 signal cards this week". i'll build a short cheat sheet for CS playbook.
OnboardBot: Onboarding session: Nebula Inc complete. raw transcript uploaded. recommend converting 2 lines into Signal Card format.
Tom Nguyen: i'll trim two items from Nebula's notes and add them to the sheet later today.
Maya Lopez: will run the 2-week pilot starting Monday and post a short summary (cards captured, tags distribution, 1 notable P0/P1) in #customer-success. excited to see if this reduces noise for PMs. :rocket:
